description: This file implements a sample VoiceRecognitionService that extends Android's RecognitionService. It simulates voice recognition results based on user preferences, returning either a list of letters or numbers without performing real recognition.

classes.name: VoiceRecognitionService
classes.description: A mock implementation of RecognitionService that returns predefined recognition results based on stored preferences.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Handles the cancel event. In a real recognizer, this would shut down recognition processes.

methods.name: onStartListening
methods.description: Handles the start of listening, generates mock results based on preferences, and passes results via callback.

methods.name: onStopListening
methods.description: Handles the stop listening event. Not implemented in this sample.
